basis: Focal seizures arise from localized cerebral dysfunction; no additional organ involvement defines this umbrella.
Pontocerebellar neurodegeneration; muscle atrophy and scoliosis each 7/8; cataract and optic atrophy each 4/8. Neurogenic dysphagia does not establish GI damage.
Malignant neoplasm occupying the renal pelvis; other organ involvement is not intrinsic to this concept.
Primary failure of adrenal hormone production; autoimmune causation does not apply to every subtype.
Adenocarcinoma arising from the exocrine pancreas; metastatic sites are not defining involvement.
Obstetric implantation disorder outside the endometrial cavity; reproductive organs have no axis. Hemorrhage is a complication.
Congenital connection between the ascending aorta and a ventricle; associated structural abnormalities and heart failure remain cardiovascular.
Fetal urethral obstruction damages the urinary tract; pulmonary hypoplasia from oligohydramnios is a defining component of this sequence.
Testicular germ-cell neoplasm arises in reproductive tissue, not the hormone-producing gonadal compartment.
Papillary epithelial neoplasm of the urinary bladder urothelium; bladder belongs to the renal axis.
Defined skeletal myopathy with weakness and contractures; possible cardiomyopathy lacks frequency evidence, and respiratory weakness does not establish lung damage.
Infection defined by the viral genus Cardiovirus; the genus name does not establish cardiac involvement or a common damaged organ.
Craniosynostosis and developmental disability define it; gingival overgrowth 80-99%, anal and cardiac anomalies 30-79%; strabismus 30-79% omitted at cap.
Coffin-Siris phenotype with ID/microcephaly, fifth-nail hypoplasia and digital anomalies; ocular/endocrine defects vary; renal malrotation alone need not impair function.
Congenital heart defects, especially VSD, are a defining manifestation; phenotype is highly variable and frequencies of other damaging malformations are unavailable.
Pigmentation is localized to fungiform papillae of the tongue, an oral structure within the gastrointestinal axis.
Oocyte maturation and pronucleus formation defect causing female infertility; no endocrine dysfunction is established.
Immune hyperactivation with hemophagocytosis, cytopenias, coagulopathy and defining liver dysfunction; encephalopathy occurs in only 5-29%.
Open iniencephaly is a neural tube defect with encephalocele and defining occipital and cervicothoracic vertebral malformations.
Perineurial nerve-sheath tumor usually arising in dermis or subcutis, without an identifiable nerve association; visceral locations are rare.
Epilepsy and persistent dystonia define a neurological syndrome; nystagmus reflects motor control dysfunction without established ocular damage.
Congenital upper-lip cleft affects the mouth; frequent chronic otitis media is a separately diagnosed disease, so otologic involvement is excluded.
Acquired rippling myopathy is generally immune-mediated; associated myasthenia gravis is a separate disease and does not establish neurological involvement.
Acquired hepatic uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase deficiency causes porphyrin accumulation and defining photosensitive blistering with skin fragility.
Neurodegeneration causes parkinsonism and central hypoventilation; common respiratory failure reflects loss of central drive, without direct lung damage.
